POST http://<GATEWAY_IP>/v1/chat/completions
Content-Type: application/json
x-portkey-api-key: <SCM Workspace API Key>
{ "model": "@openai/gpt-4o-mini", "messages": [ ... ] }

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 536px; height: 1px; padding-top: 552px; margin-left: 558px;

div.span:
The slug goes in the model field, not a header.
Organizations with block_inline_config enabled reject the
x-portkey-provider header with inline_provider_blocked.
Referencing the saved integration as @<slug>/<model> works
either way, so this guide always does that.
